label: semete
title: せめて
meaning: at least,  at most a small thing
meaning_example: at least I want to finish

examples.japanese: せめてなべでもあれば、ご飯が炊けるんですが
examples.body_text:
せめてなべでもあれば、ご飯が炊けるんですが 

		If we 
		at least 
		had a pot, we could cook rice
examples.body_html:
せめてなべでもあれば、ご飯が炊けるんですが 
If we at least had a pot, we could cook rice

examples.japanese: せめてつまらないものですが、、
examples.body_text:
せめてつまらないものですが、、 

at most 
		an uninteresting thing, but ...
examples.body_html:
せめてつまらないものですが、、 
at most an uninteresting thing, but ...

examples.japanese: せめて両親には分かって貰いたいんですが
examples.body_text:

At least

せめて両親には分かって貰いたいんですが 
At least I want to be understood by my parents

examples.japanese: じゃ、せめてテーブルの準備でもしましょう。
examples.body_text:
じゃ、せめてテーブルの準備でもしましょう。

examples.body_html:

examples.japanese: せめて後十分待ってくれませんか。
examples.body_text:
せめて後十分待ってくれませんか。 

		Can't you wait 
		just 
		ten more minutes?

Can't you wait just ten more minutes?

examples.japanese: せめて謝ってくれてもいいのに。
examples.body_text:
せめて謝ってくれてもいいのに。 

		He might 
		at least 
		apologize.
examples.body_html:
せめて謝ってくれてもいいのに。 
He might at least apologize.

examples.japanese: せめて日常会話ができるくらいになりたい。
examples.body_text:
せめて日常会話ができるくらいになりたい。 

At the very least, 
		I'd like to be able to have everyday conversations.
examples.body_html:
せめて日常会話ができるくらいになりたい。

examples.japanese: せめて病気のときぐらいは、お酒を飲まないぐらいの分別は持つべきだ。
examples.body_text:
せめて病気のときぐらいは、お酒を飲まないぐらいの分別は持つべきだ。 

		You should have enough sense not to drink, 
		at least 
		during your illness.
examples.body_html:
せめて病気のときぐらいは、お酒を飲まないぐらいの分別は持つべきだ。 
You should have enough sense not to drink, at least during your illness.

examples.japanese: せめてもう一日あれば
examples.body_text:
せめてもう一日あれば 

		Had we 
		at least 
		one more day!
examples.body_html:
せめてもう一日あれば 
Had we at least one more day!

examples.japanese: せめてもう一度だけ、笑顔を見せて。
examples.body_text:
せめてもう一度だけ、笑顔を見せて。 

		At least show me your smiling face just one last time.
examples.body_html:
せめてもう一度だけ、笑顔を見せて。

comments.text: You can say せめてのもの instead of せめて. せめてのもの is stronger than せめて.

comments.text: 攻めて and 責めて are the only two kanji that come up for this word. 責めて means to criticize, condemn or blame. Maybe せめて means (at it's core) "Even if you closely examine this situation, x should be expected." I don't know if this is true or not, but it's a thought.
comments.html: 攻めて and 責めて are the only two kanji that come up for this word. 責めて means to criticize, condemn or blame. Maybe せめて means (at it's core) "Even if you closely examine this situation, x should be expected." I don't know if this is true or not, but it's a thought.

comments.text: 攻めて and 責めて are not equivalent of せめて, but せめて did derive from 責む in 連用形 form with connective て. In archaic use, there were several other meanings associated with せめて, but what we now have is "although not sufficient, at least this much if the situation compels."
